paragraphs.text: Mount Mercadia is a mountain on Mercadia which is very unusual; it is upside-down.
On its top (on what would be the bottom of its base if it was the right way up) is Mercadia City , with the Lower Market in the mountain's noonday shadow. Many players mistook it for a tornado.

Mercadia City - the capital city of the plane, spread out both atop and below the mountain. The Cliffside Market - the market running along the edge of the city, thick with booths, crowds, and noise. The High Market - the market crowning the top of Mercadia City, where the most exotic goods can be found. The Lower Market - situated beneath the inverted mountain inside a ring of trash. The Tower of the Magistrate - seat of rule over Mercadia, placed directly in the center of the city.
The Subterranean Hangar - a subterranean dock for airships
